[Section] Dataset
[source_id=11] We introduce a new crowdsourced dataset of 23,700 queries, including 22,500 in-scope queries covering 150 intents, which can be grouped into 10 general domains. The dataset also includes 1,200 out-of-scope queries. Table TABREF2 shows examples of the data.
